notes.title: Demo Version Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]Mia Is Ready to Meet You!
[/h1]

[h1]Great news, everyone! 
[/h1]

The demo version of the game is already live on our page for you to download and play!

We invite all of you to embark on an adventure, experiencing one of the five thrilling game days and getting acquainted with Mia. Give the demo a shot, and please, let your voices be heard. Your feedback means the world to us!

Twisted Rabbits

notes.title: MY VIRGIN ROOMMATE DEMO COMING SOON!!!
notes.content:
[h2]Friends! We are thrilled to announce that we will be releasing the demo version of our game very soon.[/h2]

While you wait for the game's release, we invite you to try out the demo and experience 1 out of the 5 gameplay days that will be available in the full version.

Thank you to everyone who has added the game to their wishlist and is following our updates.
We look forward to your feedback and engagement on our page.

[i][b]Twisted Rabbits
[/b][/i]
